snippet.title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2 - Exclusive Gameplay and Playtest Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Build your roster of Creepy Horrors in this spooky occult creature-collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting cursed curios and ingredients, combining them to summon adorable Horrors, wielding them in strategic 3v3 battles against rival sects. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer?
